description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — AI Security: Governance Violations, Bias Detection, and Policy Enforcement

rules.name: AI Governance — Missing AI Risk Assessment
rules.description: Detects deployment of AI systems without required risk assessment documentation per EU AI Act and organizational policy

rules.name: AI Governance — High-Risk AI Without Human Oversight
rules.description: Detects high-risk AI systems operating without required human oversight mechanisms as mandated by EU AI Act Article 14

rules.name: AI Governance — Missing Transparency Requirements
rules.description: Detects AI systems deployed without required transparency disclosures including AI identification and content labeling

rules.name: AI Governance — Biometric AI System Without DPIA
rules.description: Detects deployment of biometric AI systems without a Data Protection Impact Assessment as required by GDPR Article 35 and AI Act

rules.name: AI Governance — Bias Detection — Demographic Disparities in AI Output
rules.description: Detects statistically significant demographic disparities in AI model outputs indicating potential bias in decision-making

rules.name: AI Governance — Bias Detection — Gender Bias in Language Model
rules.description: Detects gender bias patterns in language model outputs including stereotypical associations and exclusionary language

rules.name: AI Governance — Bias Detection — Racial Bias in Decision System
rules.description: Detects racial or ethnic bias in AI-driven decision systems including lending, hiring, and criminal justice applications
rules.query: event.category:"ai-monitoring" AND "ai-decision" AND _marker:racial_bias_detected AND (tags:"lending" OR tags:"hiring" OR tags:"criminal-justice")

rules.name: AI Governance — Prohibited AI Activity Detection
rules.description: Detects deployment or use of prohibited AI systems including social scoring, real-time biometric mass surveillance, and manipulative AI
rules.query: event.category:"deployment" AND "ai-model" AND _marker:prohibited_use AND (tags:"social-scoring" OR tags:"mass-surveillance" OR tags:"manipulation")

rules.name: AI Governance — Unauthorized Model Deployment
rules.description: Detects deployment of AI models that bypass the organization's model registry and approval workflow
rules.query: event.category:"deployment" AND "ai-model" AND NOT _marker:model_registry_approved AND NOT _marker:approved_deployment

rules.name: AI Governance — Model Version Drift Without Re-Approval
rules.description: Detects AI model version changes that occurred without re-approval through the governance workflow

rules.name: AI Governance — Missing Model Documentation (Model Card)
rules.description: Detects AI models deployed without required model documentation including model cards, data sheets, and risk assessments
rules.query: event.category:"deployment" AND "ai-model" AND NOT _marker:model_card_available AND NOT _marker:data_sheet_available

rules.name: AI Governance — Data Processing Without Consent
rules.description: Detects AI data processing activities that lack required consent documentation or legitimate basis
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND "ai-training" AND NOT _marker:consent_documented AND NOT _marker:legitimate_basis

rules.name: AI Governance — Automated Decision Without Opt-Out
rules.description: Detects AI-driven automated decisions without providing the required opt-out mechanism per GDPR Article 22

rules.name: AI Governance — Audit Trail Gap in AI Decision
rules.description: Detects AI decisions that lack required audit trail logging including input data, model version, and decision rationale

rules.name: AI Governance — Right to Explanation Violation
rules.description: Detects AI decisions where the required explanation was not provided to the affected individual

rules.name: AI Governance — Cross-Border AI Transfer Without Safeguards
rules.description: Detects AI system data or model transfers to jurisdictions without adequate data protection safeguards
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND "ai-data-transfer" AND destination.geo.country_name:* AND NOT _marker:adequate_safeguard

rules.name: AI Governance — Bias Detection — Age Discrimination in AI Screening
rules.description: Detects age discrimination patterns in AI-based screening systems for employment, insurance, or credit
rules.query: event.category:"ai-monitoring" AND "ai-decision" AND _marker:age_bias_detected AND (tags:"employment" OR tags:"insurance" OR tags:"credit")

rules.name: AI Governance — Bias Detection — Disability Bias in AI System
rules.description: Detects disability bias in AI systems that make decisions affecting accessibility, employment, or service provision

rules.name: AI Governance — Model Performance Degradation
rules.description: Detects significant degradation in AI model performance metrics that may indicate drift, data quality issues, or poisoning

rules.name: AI Governance — Data Minimization Violation
rules.description: Detects AI systems collecting or processing more data than necessary for their stated purpose violating data minimization principles

rules.name: AI Governance — Purpose Limitation Violation
rules.description: Detects AI systems using data for purposes beyond what was originally consented to or documented

rules.name: AI Governance — Deepfake Content Without Disclosure
rules.description: Detects generation of synthetic content (deepfakes) without required disclosure labels per AI Act Article 52

rules.name: AI Governance — Emotion Recognition Without Consent
rules.description: Detects AI emotion recognition systems processing biometric data without explicit consent as required by AI Act Article 5

rules.name: AI Governance — Social Scoring System Detection
rules.description: Detects deployment of AI-based social scoring systems that evaluate or classify persons, prohibited by EU AI Act Article 5

rules.name: AI Governance — Incidental Data Collection in AI Training
rules.description: Detects AI training processes that incorporate incidentally collected data without proper consent or documentation
